1
Osuboni Yohane asɛnka
(Mateo 3.1-12; Luka 3.1-18; Yohane 1.19-30)
1Yesu Kristo, [Nyankopɔn ba]#1.1 Tete atwerɛ afoforɔ a wɔgye tomu binom mfa Nyankopɔn ba nka ho asɛmpa no mfitiaseɛ. 2#Mal 3.1; Mat 11.10 Sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no wɔ Odiyifoɔ Yesaia nwoma no mu sɛ:
Hwɛ, meresoma me bɔfoɔ adi w’anim
ɔno na ɔbɛsiesie wo kwan.
3 # Yes 40.3 Obi nne reteam ɛserɛ so sɛ:
Monsiesie Awurade kwan!
Momma n’atempɔn ntene!
4Yohane ba bɛbɔɔ asu wɔ ɛserɛ so, na ɔkaa adwensakyera asubɔ a ɛde kɔ bɔne fakyɛ mu. 5Na Yuda asase sofoɔ nyinaa ne Yerusalemfoɔ firi kɔɔ ne nkyɛn, na wɔkaa wɔn bɔne maa no bɔɔ wɔn nyinaa asu, Asubɔnten Yordan mu.
6Na Yohane fira yoma nwi ntoma, ɛnna nwoma abɔsoɔ bɔ n’asene, na ɔdi ntutummɛ ne wiram woɔ. 7Na ɔpaee mu kaa sɛ: Deɛ ne ho yɛ den sene me di m’akyi reba a mensɛ sɛ mekoto mesane ne mpaboa homa. 8Me deɛ, mede nsuo na ɛbɔ mo asu, na ɔno deɛ, ɔde Honhom Kronkron na ɛbɛbɔ mo asu.
Yesu asubɔ
(Mateo 3.13-17; Luka 3.21-22; Yohane 1.31-34)
9 # Luk 2.51 Na ɛbaa sɛ nna no mu no, Yesu firi Nasaret a ɛwɔ Galilea bae, na Yohane bɔɔ no asu wɔ Asubɔntene Yordan mu. 10Na ɔfirii nsuo no mu no, ntɛm ara na ɔhunuu sɛ ɔsoro abue, na Honhom no resiane sɛ aburuburo aba ne soɔ. 11#Mar 9.7 Na ɛnne bi firi soro baa sɛ: Wone me dɔba a wosɔ m’ani!
Yesu sɔhwɛ
(Mateo 4.1-11; Luka 4.1-13)
12Na amonom hɔ ara, Honhom no faa no ntɛm so kɔɔ ɛserɛ so. 13Na ɔdii ɛserɛ so hɔ adaduanan, na Satan sɔɔ no hwɛe, na ɔne mmoa na ɛwɔ hɔ, na abɔfoɔ bɛsomm no.
Yesu asɛnka mfitiaseɛ
(Mateo 4.12-17; Luka 4.14-15)
14Na wɔyii Yohane maeɛ akyiri no, Yesu baa Galilea bɛkaa Nyankopɔn ho asɛmpa kyerɛe. 15#Gal 4.4 Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛberɛ no awie du, Nyankopɔn ahennie no abɛn. Monsakyera mo adwene, na monnye asɛmpa no nni.
Yesu frɛ Asuafoɔ a wɔdi kan
(Mateo 4.18-22; Luka 5.1-11)
16Na ɔnenam Galilea Po ho no, ɔhunuu Simon ne ne nua Andrea sɛ wɔregu asau ɛpo no mu; ɛfiri sɛ na wɔyɛ apofofoɔ. 17Na Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Mommɛdi m’akyi, na mɛma moayɛ nnipa yifoɔ. 18Na ntɛm ara wɔgyaa wɔn asau no hɔ bɛdii n’akyi. 19Na ɔfiri hɔ kɔɔ n’anim kakra no, ɔhunuu Sebedeo ba Yakobo ne ne nua Yohane sɛ wɔn nso wɔ kodoɔ mu retetɛ wɔn asau mu. 20Na ntɛm ara ɔfrɛɛ wɔn, na wɔgyaa wɔn agya Sebedeo ne apaafoɔ no kodoɔ no mu bɛdii n’akyi.
Yesu tu honhom fi
(Luka 4.31-37)
21Na wɔkɔduruu Kapernaum. Na homeda duruiɛ no, ntɛm ara ɔkɔɔ hyiadan mu kɔkyerɛkyerɛeɛ. 22#Mat 7.28-29 Na ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no yɛɛ wɔn ahodwiri, ɛfiri sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ deɛ ɔwɔ tumi, na ɛnyɛ sɛ Atwerɛfoɔ no! 23Na ɛberɛ korɔ no ara, na onipa bi wɔ wɔn hyiadan no mu a ɔwɔ honhom fi, na ɔteaa mu sɛ: 24#Mar 5.7; Dwom 16.10 Ɛdeɛn na yɛne wo Yesu Nasareni wɔ yɛ? Wobaa sɛ worebɛsɛe yɛn anaa? Menim wo nipa ban, Onyankopɔn Hoteeni no. 25Na Yesu teateaa no sɛ: Mua w’ano na firi ne mu kɔ! 26#Mar 9.26 Na honhom fi no maa no senseneeɛ, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu, na ɔfirii ne mu kɔeɛ. 27Na ɛyɛɛ wɔn nyinaa ahodwiri maa wɔbisabisaa wɔn ho sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ni? Nkyerɛkyerɛ foforɔ! Ɔde tumi hyɛ ahonhom fi mpo na wɔtie no. 28Na ɛhɔ ara na ne ho asɛm firi trɛ kɔɔ Galilea nsase a atwa ho ahyia nyinaa so.
Yesu sa nkurɔfoɔ pii nyarewa
(Mateo 8.14-17; Luka 4.38-41)
29Na wɔfirii hyiadan no mu no, ntɛm ara na wɔne Yakobo ne Yohane kɔɔ Simon ne Andrea fie. 30Na Simon asebaa afoɛ da hɔ, na ntɛm ara wɔkaa ne ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no. 31Na Yesu ba bɛsɔɔ ne nsa maa no so, na foɛ no gyaee, na ɔfirii aseɛ somm wɔn.
32Na ɛduruu anwummerɛ a owia kɔtɔeɛ no, wɔde wɔn a wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn den ne wɔn a wɔwɔ ahonhommɔne nyinaa brɛɛ no. 33Na kuro mu no nyinaa bɛkyeree so ɛpono no ano. 34#Luk 4.41; Aso 16.17-18 Na ɔsaa nnipa bebree a wɔyare nyarewa ahodoɔ pii yadeɛ, na ɔtuu ahonhommɔne pii; na wamma ahonhommɔne no kwan sɛ wɔnkasa, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔnim no.
Yesu asɛnka wɔ Galilea
(Luka 4.42-44)
35Na ɔsɔree ahemadakye firii adi, na ɔkɔɔ ɛserɛ so baabi kɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ wɔ hɔ. 36Na Simon ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho no tii no; 37na wɔhunuu no no, wɔsee no sɛ: Nnipa nyinaa rehwehwɛ wo. 38Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Momma yɛnkɔ nkuro a ɛdeda hɔ no mu, na menkɔka asɛmpa no ɛhɔ nso; na yei nti na mebaeɛ. 39Na ɔkɔ kɔkaa asɛm no wɔ wɔn hyia adan mu wɔ Galilea nyinaa, na ɔtuu ahonhommɔne.
Ɔkwatani bi ayaresa
(Mateo 8.2-4; Luka 5.12-16)
40Na ɔkwatani bi baa ne nkyɛn bɛsrɛɛ no, na ɔkotoo no, see no sɛ: Sɛ wopɛ a, wobɛtumi ama me ho afi. 41Na ɔyɛɛ no mmɔbɔ, na ɔtenee ne nsa kaa no, na ɔsee no sɛ: Mepɛ, wo ho mfi. 42Na ntɛm ara, kwata no firii ne ho, na ne ho firiiɛ. 43#Mar 3.12; 7.36 Na Yesu baraa no dendeenden, na ɔmaa no firii adi ntɛm ara. 44#Lew 14.2-32 Na ɔsee no sɛ: Hwɛ, nka asɛm biara nkyerɛ obiara, na kɔ na fa wo ho kɔkyerɛ ɔsɔfoɔ na w’ahofire nti, kɔma deɛ Mose hyɛeɛ no, na ɛnyɛ adanseɛ mma wɔn! 45Na ɔno deɛ, ɔfirii adie no, ɔfitii aseɛ kekaa no pii, na ɔmaa asɛm no trɛe, ɛno nti Yesu antumi anyi n’anim ankɔ kuro biara mu bio; na mmom ɔtenaa ɛserɛ so hɔnom baabi, na wɔfiri mmaa nyinaa baa ne nkyɛn.

Yesu Kristo, [Nyankopɔn ba] asɛmpa no mfitiaseɛ. Sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no wɔ Odiyifoɔ Yesaia nwoma no mu sɛ:
Hwɛ, meresoma me bɔfoɔ adi w’anim
ɔno na ɔbɛsiesie wo kwan.
Obi nne reteam ɛserɛ so sɛ:
Monsiesie Awurade kwan!
Momma n’atempɔn ntene!
Yohane ba bɛbɔɔ asu wɔ ɛserɛ so, na ɔkaa adwensakyera asubɔ a ɛde kɔ bɔne fakyɛ mu. Na Yuda asase sofoɔ nyinaa ne Yerusalemfoɔ firi kɔɔ ne nkyɛn, na wɔkaa wɔn bɔne maa no bɔɔ wɔn nyinaa asu, Asubɔnten Yordan mu.
Na Yohane fira yoma nwi ntoma, ɛnna nwoma abɔsoɔ bɔ n’asene, na ɔdi ntutummɛ ne wiram woɔ. Na ɔpaee mu kaa sɛ: Deɛ ne ho yɛ den sene me di m’akyi reba a mensɛ sɛ mekoto mesane ne mpaboa homa. Me deɛ, mede nsuo na ɛbɔ mo asu, na ɔno deɛ, ɔde Honhom Kronkron na ɛbɛbɔ mo asu.


Na ɛbaa sɛ nna no mu no, Yesu firi Nasaret a ɛwɔ Galilea bae, na Yohane bɔɔ no asu wɔ Asubɔntene Yordan mu. Na ɔfirii nsuo no mu no, ntɛm ara na ɔhunuu sɛ ɔsoro abue, na Honhom no resiane sɛ aburuburo aba ne soɔ. Na ɛnne bi firi soro baa sɛ: Wone me dɔba a wosɔ m’ani!


Na amonom hɔ ara, Honhom no faa no ntɛm so kɔɔ ɛserɛ so. Na ɔdii ɛserɛ so hɔ adaduanan, na Satan sɔɔ no hwɛe, na ɔne mmoa na ɛwɔ hɔ, na abɔfoɔ bɛsomm no.


Na wɔyii Yohane maeɛ akyiri no, Yesu baa Galilea bɛkaa Nyankopɔn ho asɛmpa kyerɛe. Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛberɛ no awie du, Nyankopɔn ahennie no abɛn. Monsakyera mo adwene, na monnye asɛmpa no nni.


Na ɔnenam Galilea Po ho no, ɔhunuu Simon ne ne nua Andrea sɛ wɔregu asau ɛpo no mu; ɛfiri sɛ na wɔyɛ apofofoɔ. Na Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Mommɛdi m’akyi, na mɛma moayɛ nnipa yifoɔ. Na ntɛm ara wɔgyaa wɔn asau no hɔ bɛdii n’akyi. Na ɔfiri hɔ kɔɔ n’anim kakra no, ɔhunuu Sebedeo ba Yakobo ne ne nua Yohane sɛ wɔn nso wɔ kodoɔ mu retetɛ wɔn asau mu. Na ntɛm ara ɔfrɛɛ wɔn, na wɔgyaa wɔn agya Sebedeo ne apaafoɔ no kodoɔ no mu bɛdii n’akyi.


Na wɔkɔduruu Kapernaum. Na homeda duruiɛ no, ntɛm ara ɔkɔɔ hyiadan mu kɔkyerɛkyerɛeɛ. Na ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no yɛɛ wɔn ahodwiri, ɛfiri sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ deɛ ɔwɔ tumi, na ɛnyɛ sɛ Atwerɛfoɔ no! Na ɛberɛ korɔ no ara, na onipa bi wɔ wɔn hyiadan no mu a ɔwɔ honhom fi, na ɔteaa mu sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛne wo Yesu Nasareni wɔ yɛ? Wobaa sɛ worebɛsɛe yɛn anaa? Menim wo nipa ban, Onyankopɔn Hoteeni no. Na Yesu teateaa no sɛ: Mua w’ano na firi ne mu kɔ! Na honhom fi no maa no senseneeɛ, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu, na ɔfirii ne mu kɔeɛ. Na ɛyɛɛ wɔn nyinaa ahodwiri maa wɔbisabisaa wɔn ho sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ni? Nkyerɛkyerɛ foforɔ! Ɔde tumi hyɛ ahonhom fi mpo na wɔtie no. Na ɛhɔ ara na ne ho asɛm firi trɛ kɔɔ Galilea nsase a atwa ho ahyia nyinaa so.


Na wɔfirii hyiadan no mu no, ntɛm ara na wɔne Yakobo ne Yohane kɔɔ Simon ne Andrea fie. Na Simon asebaa afoɛ da hɔ, na ntɛm ara wɔkaa ne ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no. Na Yesu ba bɛsɔɔ ne nsa maa no so, na foɛ no gyaee, na ɔfirii aseɛ somm wɔn.
Na ɛduruu anwummerɛ a owia kɔtɔeɛ no, wɔde wɔn a wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn den ne wɔn a wɔwɔ ahonhommɔne nyinaa brɛɛ no. Na kuro mu no nyinaa bɛkyeree so ɛpono no ano. Na ɔkwatani bi baa ne nkyɛn bɛsrɛɛ no, na ɔkotoo no, see no sɛ: Sɛ wopɛ a, wobɛtumi ama me ho afi. Na ɔyɛɛ no mmɔbɔ, na ɔtenee ne nsa kaa no, na ɔsee no sɛ: Mepɛ, wo ho mfi. Na ntɛm ara, kwata no firii ne ho, na ne ho firiiɛ. Na Yesu baraa no dendeenden, na ɔmaa no firii adi ntɛm ara. Na ɔsee no sɛ: Hwɛ, nka asɛm biara nkyerɛ obiara, na kɔ na fa wo ho kɔkyerɛ ɔsɔfoɔ na w’ahofire nti, kɔma deɛ Mose hyɛeɛ no, na ɛnyɛ adanseɛ mma wɔn! app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
